summary: Frontend-only validation of the 3 requested fixes in SinaisTab.jsx + Dashboard.jsx: (1) color-mismatch = immediate LOSS, (2) activeTab persistence in localStorage across reloads, (3) scoreboard persistence in sessionStorage. All 5 test scenarios PASSED end-to-end via the live preview URL.

tests_executed.name: TEST 1 - COLOR MISMATCH = IMMEDIATE LOSS
tests_executed.observations: LIMPAR → 3,20,17 → signal fires target=BAIXO, numbers=[2,4,6,8,10,11] (dominant=black), '3 tentativas restantes'. Clicked 5 (BAIXO red = correct category, wrong color). Signal immediately cleared to 'Aguardando sequência...' AND LOSS counter went 0→1 in the same tick. sessionStorage confirmed {"wins":0,"reds":1}. Critically, the signal did NOT show '2 tentativas restantes' — the miss was resolved as an IMMEDIATE LOSS as required.

tests_executed.name: TEST 2 - WRONG CATEGORY = NORMAL MISS
tests_executed.observations: LIMPAR → 3,20,17 → signal fires target=BAIXO. Clicked 25 (ALTO = completely different category). Signal remained ACTIVE with '2 tentativas restantes'. LOSS counter unchanged (still 1). Confirms wrong-category clicks decrement attempts (normal miss) rather than counting as immediate LOSS.

tests_executed.name: TEST 3 - WIN still works
tests_executed.observations: With signal still active from Test 2 (BAIXO [2,4,6,8,10,11], 2 tentativas), clicked 2 (BAIXO black = correct cat + correct color). WIN counter incremented 0→1. sessionStorage confirmed {"wins":1,"reds":1}.

tests_executed.name: TEST 4 - activeTab persistence (Dashboard.jsx)
tests_executed.observations: Before reload: localStorage.activeTab='sinais'. Called page.reload(). After reload: localStorage.activeTab='sinais', [data-testid=sinais-tab] still in DOM, tab-sinais button has 'active' class, tab-radar does NOT have 'active' class. User stays on Em Construção tab after reload, no longer defaults to Radar. Sinais password prompt did NOT re-appear because sessionStorage 'sinais_auth' still valid within the same browser session.

tests_executed.name: TEST 5 - Scoreboard persistence (sessionStorage)
tests_executed.observations: Before reload: WIN:1 LOSS:1, sessionStorage.gatilho_score={"wins":1,"reds":1}. After reload: WIN:1 LOSS:1 rendered on the scoreboard, sessionStorage still {"wins":1,"reds":1}. Scoreboard was correctly rehydrated from sessionStorage on component mount via the useState lazy initializer at line 119-121.

critical_code_review_comments: SinaisTab.jsx lines 164-168: new 'color mismatch = immediate LOSS' branch correctly uses getCategory(lastNum) === sig.target to short-circuit the 3-attempt loop. Logic is clean and correctly ordered AFTER the sig.numbers.includes(lastNum) WIN branch, so a number that matches both cat+color still wins.

SinaisTab.jsx lines 119-127: scoreboard useState lazy initializer + useEffect writer to sessionStorage is a solid pattern. Note it uses sessionStorage (not localStorage), so scores reset when the browser tab is closed — this appears intentional (session-scoped scoring) and matches the request.
Dashboard.jsx lines 16-21: activeTab lazy init from localStorage + useEffect writer works. Same pattern already existed for viewMode.
Zero (0) short-circuit: line 164 correctly excludes lastNum !== 0 before category check. getCategory(0) already returns null so the guard is defensive-only but harmless.
SinaisTab.jsx is now 487 lines — still under the 700-line soft limit. Same recommendation as iteration_13: consider extracting sub-cards to their own files eventually.

Note: since giros is polled from localStorage every 300ms and shared with RadarTab, in-flight edits in RadarTab could theoretically race with signal resolution here — no issue observed in this test but worth keeping in mind.
